tasks.name: 2027 Community Collaboration Challenge
tasks.notes: The 2027 CCC provides $3,000 to $8,000 awards to help schools, districts, nonprofits, higher education institutions, government agencies, and community partners cross-design, plan, or pilot solutions across five key support areas: high-impact tutoring, mentoring, student success coaching, postsecondary transition coaching, and wraparound/integrated student supports.

tasks.name: Work with CEO to review list of funders for location specific funding
tasks.notes: Track progress toward establishing 10 new sites with at least 3 new district/community partnerships
